reason: Revision r2 answers REV-20260926-24. Every verdict now needs a usable operating point at recall >= 0.7. The record stays the same so that only the reason line differs. Model inputs are allowlisted and kept apart from labels. Each half needs a minimum number of repositories and of items per class. Negative results count as exploratory defaults only. It stays the cheap exploration slot (about 1.3M tokens). It could seed a new belief on how records are stored and decide whether P5's reason field becomes mandatory.
